## Layout Blueprint

The file `layout-blueprint.svg` is the auto-selected spatial wireframe for **hero-logos-features**. It encodes:

- Component placement and relative sizing
- Information hierarchy (what goes above the fold)
- Navigation patterns and content density

This wireframe was pre-selected by the pipeline based on niche analysis. Use it as a spatial reference when prompting an LLM to build UI:

```
Build [component] following the spatial layout in layout-blueprint.svg.
Use design tokens from .design-pipeline/tokens/shadcn-globals.css for colors and typography.
```


## shadcn/ui Integration

1. Copy `shadcn-globals.css` to your project (e.g. `src/app/globals.css`)
2. The file uses HSL color variables compatible with shadcn/ui
3. Dark mode is supported via three mechanisms:
   - `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` — automatic OS preference detection
   - `[data-theme="dark"]` — explicit attribute toggle (e.g. theme switcher)
   - `.dark` class — compatible with `next-themes` and Tailwind `darkMode: "class"`
4. Font family variables are set on `--font-heading`, `--font-body`, `--font-mono`


## Generic CSS Integration

1. Import `design-tokens.css` at the top of your main CSS file
2. All tokens are available as CSS custom properties (`--color-primary`, etc.)
3. Dark mode is supported via:
   - `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` — automatic OS preference detection
   - `[data-theme="dark"]` — explicit attribute toggle for theme switchers
4. Utility classes (`.text-primary`, `.bg-primary`) are included
5. Spacing uses `--space-xs` through `--space-section`


## DaisyUI Integration

1. Import `daisyui-theme.css` in your project
2. Set `data-theme="bespoke"` on your `<html>` element for light mode
3. Set `data-theme="bespoke-dark"` for dark mode
4. If using Tailwind + DaisyUI plugin, register the theme in your CSS:
   ```css
   @import "tailwindcss";
   @plugin "daisyui";
   @import "./daisyui-theme.css";
   ```
5. All DaisyUI components will automatically use your brand colors


## AgnosticUI Integration

1. Import `agnosticui-tokens.css` AFTER AgnosticUI's base CSS
2. Semantic tokens (`--ag-primary`, `--ag-text-primary`, etc.) are overridden with your brand palette
3. Dark mode via `[data-theme="dark"]` on your `<html>` element
4. Primitive color scales (--ag-blue-50 through --ag-blue-900, etc.) are left at defaults
5. All AgnosticUI components will use your overridden tokens

## Design Constraints Checklist

### Accessibility

- [ ] **Icon Button Labels** — Add aria-label to icon buttons
- [ ] **Form Control Labels** — Use label element or aria-label
- [ ] **Keyboard Handlers** — Add onKeyDown alongside onClick
- [ ] **Semantic HTML** — Use button/a/label elements
- [ ] **Visible Focus States** — Use :focus-visible with ring/outline
- [ ] **Never Remove Outline** — Replace outline with visible alternative
- [ ] **Autocomplete Attribute** — Add appropriate autocomplete value
- [ ] **Never Block Paste** — Allow paste on all inputs

### Interaction

- [ ] **Keyboard Operability** — Ensure interactive elements support full keyboard navigation
- [ ] **Focus Indicators** — Ensure focus-visible styles are applied to all interactive elements
- [ ] **Button States** — Ensure all buttons and links provide feedback on hover/focus (e.g., change color or background)
- [ ] **Timeouts and Auto-Submit** — Provide clear user notifications or cancel options for auto-submitting actions or timeouts
- [ ] **Accessible Error Messages** — Provide clear inline error messages associated with form fields
- [ ] **Skip Navigation** — Add a skip navigation link at the top of the page
- [ ] **Accessible Links** — Ensure all links have meaningful, descriptive text or aria-labels
- [ ] **Modal Accessibility** — Ensure modals trap focus within and provide easy escape via escape key or close button
- [ ] **Drag and Drop Accessibility** — Provide alternative ways to interact with drag-and-drop features (e.g., buttons for each action)
- [ ] **Focusable Elements** — Ensure all interactive elements are reachable via keyboard navigation (tabindex)
- [ ] **Accessible Controls** — Use <label> or aria-label to provide accessible names for form controls
- [ ] **Testable State Changes** — Use ARIA live regions or other mechanisms to announce state changes dynamically

### Performance

- [ ] **Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)**: LCP <=2.5s — Optimize hero assets and critical path
- [ ] **First Contentful Paint (FCP)**: FCP <=1.8s — Optimize rendering path and reduce critical JS
- [ ] **Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)**: CLS <=0.1 — Reserve space for dynamic content
- [ ] **Time to Interactive (TTI)**: TTI <=5s — Reduce JavaScript execution time and optimize load
- [ ] **Total Blocking Time (TBT)**: TBT <=200ms — Defer non-essential JavaScript and reduce long tasks
- [ ] **First Input Delay (FID)**: FID <=100ms — Minimize JavaScript and prioritize interactivity
- [ ] **Interactive to Next Paint (INP)**: INP <=200ms — Reduce main-thread work and improve response times
- [ ] **JavaScript Execution**: JavaScript execution <=200ms main thread — Split code
- [ ] **Image Efficiency**: Lighthouse Pass — Optimize images with responsive and compressed formats
- [ ] **Lazy Loading Images**: Lighthouse Pass — Use loading='lazy' on below-the-fold images
- [ ] **Preconnect to Critical Domains**: Preconnect Pass — Add <link rel="preconnect" href="..."> for critical resources
- [ ] **Font Display Strategy**: Font-display Swap — Use font-display: swap for better text rendering
- [ ] **Avoid Large Layout Shifts**: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) <=0.1 — Reserve space for images
- [ ] **Avoid Main Thread Work**: Batch DOM Operations <=150ms main thread — Minimize heavy JavaScript tasks and prioritize async loading
- [ ] **Reduce Unused JavaScript**: Lighthouse <=10% — Implement tree-shaking and defer unused JS
- [ ] **Avoid Inline CSS**: Inline CSS <=10KB — Move CSS to external stylesheets for better performance
- [ ] **Efficient CSS Selectors**: Selector efficiency Pass — Optimize CSS selectors for better performance
- [ ] **Keep Requests Low**: HTTP Requests <=50 requests — Combine and minify assets to reduce requests
- [ ] **Reduce Server Response Time**: Server Response Time <=200ms — Optimize backend and reduce response time
